name: coplan
description: Open-source visual planning workspace for coding agents: shape the plan as architecture diagrams and a task board in the browser, submit it, and follow the build.

interface.shortDescription: Plan on a canvas, then follow the build
interface.longDescription: Codex publishes its plan to a local browser workspace: the architecture as diagrams you can rewire and annotate, and a task tree you can reorganize. Review the exact build prompt, submit it, and follow each task across the board as Codex builds.
defaultPrompt: Plan this in Coplan before we build it
